# p-vs-np-frontier-lab

> Machine-Checked Barrier Anatomy and Twelve Divergent Pathways Toward P vs. NP.
> Author: Alexander S. Donahue (Independent Researcher, ORCID 0009-0006-8168-9648).
> Epistemic Scope: P vs. NP remains OPEN. Zero claims of P = NP or P != NP.

## Core Artifacts
- [README.md](README.md): Overview, 5-second Lean axiom check, Statement-Fidelity Table, repo map.
- [CLAIMS.md](CLAIMS.md): Machine-auditable ledger of Tier-1 Lean theorems (C1-C14), Tier-2/3 experiments (E1-E10), and Tier-4 open frontiers (O1-O3).
- [LIMITATIONS.md](LIMITATIONS.md): Explicit boundaries, CTDS float64 disclaimer, CLIQUE_4_3 open bound, upstream Windows Lean 4.35 toolchain notes.
- [REPLICATION.md](REPLICATION.md): Exact Windows and Linux clean-room reproduction commands.
- [lean/Challenge.lean](lean/Challenge.lean): Human-auditable specifications of all 14 unconditional theorems (zero proofs).
- [lean/Solution.lean](lean/Solution.lean): Witness terms proving C1-C14 and AllFrontierTheoremsStmt (zero Mathlib, zero sorry).
- [lean/formalization.yaml](lean/formalization.yaml): Structured mapping of C1-C14 to Lean modules, verbatim axioms, and 6-kernel audit verdicts.
- [results/six_kernel_audit.txt](results/six_kernel_audit.txt): Verbatim multi-kernel verification log (lean, leanchecker, leanchecker-paranoid, con-leche --verified, con-ron --verified, nanoda_bin).
- [tests/test_all.py](tests/test_all.py): 10-test verification suite including exhaustive brute-force SAT-encoder audit on n=3.
- [paper/main.tex](paper/main.tex): 15-page AMS-LaTeX white paper (zero Overfull/Underfull hboxes).
- [docs/10-pass-review.md](docs/10-pass-review.md): Complete 10-pass adversarial audit and six-class findings catalog.
